gen-gf-goldman-gf-ramabhadra: Ramabhadra reads with a tall, prominent lowercase that keeps text easy to take in. And Goldman, with its wide-set letters and round forms like open parentheses, is the one that gets to be loud.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-roboto-condensed: Commanding is how Goldman looks, its wide letters spaced out and its rounded shapes curving like open parentheses. But Roboto Condensed sits tight beside it, words packed close and lines gliding along like wire.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-secular-one:
Goldman spreads its letters wide and generous, bold from the first glance.

Secular One answers with a big lowercase body and strokes that never thin out, so paragraphs would feel dense, sturdy and modern.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-spline-sans-mono: Wide, bold and a bit theatrical, Goldman leads with round forms like open parentheses. And Spline Sans Mono, with its fixed-width letters and lowercase nearly matching the capitals, would read as steady, typewriter-like text paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-victor-mono:
Goldman is wide, round and commanding, its curves like open parentheses.

Victor Mono does the quieter job, with loose spacing and bowls that never swell, while Goldman is the one that wants to be big and bold.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-viga:
Goldman stretches its letters wide, with a tall lowercase and rounded forms like open parentheses.

Viga would read smoothly over a long page, every stroke cut to one width and its capitals barely taller than the letters beside them.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-winky-sans: Round forms that curve like open parentheses give Goldman its commanding look, with wide-set letters and a big lowercase. And Winky Sans, a modern sans-serif with capitals barely taller than lowercase, would read smoothly through a long paragraph.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-yantramanav:
Goldman's round, parenthesis-like curves and wide spacing make it bold and commanding.

Yantramanav, a sans-serif with tall lowercase and letters huddled close, stays out of its way.
gen-gf-goldman-sora:
Wide, bold and rounded, Goldman looks like a row of open parentheses with a big lowercase, while Sora keeps its curves smooth and its c and s widely parted.

Give Sora a comfortable size.
gen-gf-goldman-space-grotesk:
Commanding Goldman spreads wide with round forms like open parentheses.

Space Grotesk sits below it as a thread of constant-width ink with breathing counters, and the two make a page that is loud on top and quiet underneath.
